comments.text:
Mohit bhaiya makers ko meri taraf se bol dijiyega yah phir yeh message dikha dijiyega ki new promo leap wala bahut bekaar laga.. show kya tha, ussey kya bana diya isliye tv show aajkl lambe samay tak nhi chal paate hai.... Kitna accha jaa raha tha show pura barbaad kar diya, aur Suraj ka new look bahut bekaar lag raha hai, woh usme bilkul accha nhi lag raha hai..... Unki IAS banne ki journey dikhani chahiye thi lekin nhi beech mein Isha ki Maa ko goli maarna, Isha ki nafrat, Isha ki second marriage etc yeh sab kya hai? 
Makers ka dimaag kharab ho chuka hai puri tarah se.
